zin_state_culture_matches_owner = {
	owner = { check_variable = { var = zin_culture_id value = PREV.zin_state_culture compare = equals } }
}

zin_state_culture_same_kin_as_owner = {
	OR = {
		zin_state_culture_matches_owner = yes
		AND = { check_variable = { zin_state_culture = 4 } owner = { check_variable = { zin_culture_id = 1 } } }
		AND = { check_variable = { zin_state_culture = 1 } owner = { check_variable = { zin_culture_id = 4 } } }
	}
}

zin_state_culture_foreign_to_owner = {
	NOT = { zin_state_culture_same_kin_as_owner = yes }
}

zin_state_faith_matches_owner = {
	owner = { check_variable = { var = zin_faith_id value = PREV.zin_state_faith compare = equals } }
}

zin_state_has_minority_culture = {
	check_variable = { zin_state_culture2 > 0 }
}
